subject: Araumycos
fact: Araumycos is a massive sentient fungal growth in the Underdark, referenced as the groom in a mock wedding rehearsal, and the natural habitat of the Myconids.
source_quote: Araumycos is the name of a massive sentient fungal growth in the Underdark. From the stories we know, it is the natural habitat of the Myconids.

subject: Zuggtmoy
fact: Zuggtmoy is the Queen of Fungi, the Queen of decay and death, who intends to marry the Myconids and gain untold power over the world through union with Araumycos.
source_quote: Zuggtmoy intends to marry them. The Queen of Fungi is the Queen of decay and death. Her union with Araumycos will give her untold power over the world.

subject: Yestabrod's Garden of Welcome
fact: Yestabrod's Garden of Welcome is a pale reflection of the true horrors surrounding the giant mushroom Yggmorgus, featuring a 20-foot-high crescent-shaped ledge covered in moss and fungi, pockmarks of vile fluids, and an eerie luminescence pouring through slitted windows in the trunk.
source_quote: Yestabrod's Garden of Welcome is a pale reflection of the true horrors surrounding the giant mushroom, what I assume is the creature Yggmorgus. A 20-foot-high crescent-shaped ledge hugs the cavern wall and gradually slopes down to the lower basin. The ledge is covered with a carpet of moss and fungi, scores of variously sized lumps, and pockmarks where pools of vile fluids suppurate and ooze, some drying out and scabbing over. An eerie luminescence pours through slitted windows carved into the trunk, with the same cacophony of atonal music heard earlier echoing within.

subject: The Great Tower Vision
fact: The Great Tower Vision is a hallucinatory interior of a colossal structure, its walls carved with spiraling stairs and balconies, lit by phosphorescent mold in whorls, with a humanoid fungal figure three times the height of the bridesmaids floating in the center, tended by mycelium-woven lichen veils and a long mycelium train like a bridal gown.
source_quote: A vision of the inside of a great tower replaces the tableau of the mock wedding. Spiraling stairs and balconies are carved into its walls, with the interior lit by phosphorescent patches of mold growing in whorls. In the center of the open space floats a humanoid figure, womanlike in form, but made entirely of fungi and mold. She is easily three times the height of the fungal bridesmaids that move up and down the spiraling stairs, tending to their giant mistress. They croon a strange, soothing song as they weave the substance of the giant figure into delicate lichen veils and a long, mycelium train like a bridal gown.

subject: Scrolls taken by Zalthir
fact: Scrolls taken by Zalthir are refused to be given to the narrator, who asks what he will do with them later; Zalthir replies he will figure it out later.
source_quote: I noticed some scrolls and asked him if he would give them to me. He says, 'No.' Confused, I ask, 'What will you do with them later?' He cuts me off, 'I will figure it out later.'

subject: Potions of greater healing given by Basidia
fact: Potions of greater healing and minor treasure accumulated by the Myconids are handed to the party by Basidia as they leave the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: Basidia turns to us and hands some potions of greater healing and what little treasure the Mykonids had accumulated over the years from passersby.

subject: Yestabrod
fact: Yestabrod is a dead priest who assumes the role of priest in the mock wedding, and his corpse is carried by three spore servants as if a puppet to play out the part of a priest.
source_quote: Yestabrod assumes the role of priest to preside over the vows. As he is dead, three spore servants rise from the garden and carry his corpse, moving it like a puppet to play out the part of a priest.

subject: Rump-a-dump
fact: Rump-a-dump is a Myconid who gives Zalthir a list of fifty specific improvements, including 'Listen to Stool, he knows what he is doing,' and 'Eat more Zurkhwood, it's good for your digestion.'
source_quote: Rump-a-dump enumerates fifty or so specific things Zalthir could do to be better. Things like - 'Listen to Stool, he knows what he is doing. Don’t assume you know everything; other people’s points of view are important. Or my favorite, - Eat more Zurkhwood, it's good for your digestion.'

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is a Myconid companion of Rump-a-dump, referenced as someone whose knowledge Zalthir should heed, and who says 'Goodbye!' as they depart with their people.
source_quote: Rump-a-dump enumerates fifty or so specific things Zalthir could do to be better. Things like - 'Listen to Stool, he knows what he is doing...' Stool and Rump-a-dump look at me, and they say - 'Goodbye!'

subject: Phylo
fact: Phylo is a Myconid leader who has allied with the Great Seeder, pleading with Basidia not to leave, claiming 'The Neverlight Grove will be better than ever! And the Great Seeder will make us all happy!'
source_quote: Phylo plead, 'Basidia don’t go. The Neverlight Grove will be better than ever! And the Great Seeder will make us all happy!' The last words I hear are plaintive, 'Basidia don’t go.'

subject: Basidia
fact: Basidia is a Sovereign Myconid who confronts Phylo for betrayal, is grappled and dragged to safety by Zalthir, and weeps as they leave the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: Basidia, you have betrayed the Circle. You’ve allied yourself with that monster!' ... Limp in my arms, I drag them to the safety of the Circle of Explorers... And if a Myconid could sob, Basidia would be crying.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is afflicted by madness, hoarding scrolls and refusing to share them, later cured by lesser restoration, and worries about infection and losing his mind.
source_quote: Zalthir was so worried about losing his mind, and I wasn’t. And here he lost his mind, and I didn’t. ... 'I don’t know what caused this sudden need to hold onto everything.'

subject: Rasharoo
fact: Rasharoo is a Myconid guide who knows an escape hatch, urges caution, and offers to guide the party halfway to Blingdenstone before leaving them on their own.
source_quote: Rasharoo shouts into my brain, 'If you want to live, come with me.' ... Rasharoo tells us that he can provide us with a guide for half the distance to Blingdenstone, but after that, we are on our own.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is a perky gnome guide who takes over navigation, makes absurd bets, finds hidden passageways, and insists he can get the party to Blingdenstone.
source_quote: Jimjar insists he knows where he is going, 'I’ll bet you I can get you there!' ... He points to a place that we didn’t notice before, a passageway that leads into more caves. 'We should go in there!' he declares.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a cleric who casts lesser restoration on Zalthir, curing his hoarding madness, and sheds bright light that causes Myconids to retreat.
source_quote: Dawnbringer shouts, 'I can cast lesser restoration!' ... And before I can say anything, a wave of magic covers Zalthir. ... The Myconids are retreating from me.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin advises covering the mouth with a wet rag against spores, warns of madness from advancing further, and declares 'This does not seem fair.'
source_quote: Thorin shouts, 'Put a wet rag over your mouth; it may help us against any spores.' ... Thorin shouts, 'If we advance any further, we might all be afflicted by madness.' ... Thorin mutters, 'This does not seem fair.'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz screams at visions of a city of drow with no spiders, dogs as pets, and elves living with Drow, and is the first to perceive the madness of the Underdark.
source_quote: Daz starts screaming. He is saying bizarre things like - 'That’s not possible, a city of drow with no spiders? Elves and Drow living together?' ... 'Dogs? Drow with Dogs as pets?'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a Myconid who jumps and screams 'DANGER!' during the confrontation with Phylo, disrupting stealth and revealing the party's presence.
source_quote: Gyrgum starts jumping up and down and screaming, 'DANGER!'

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek is a ghost who denies possessing Zalthir, admits ignorance of fungi, and asks the narrator if they are a cleric.
source_quote: Pelek, the ghost, and ask if he knows anything about this, and he says, 'No. I am a ghost, not a fungi expert. But if you are asking if a ghost possesses him, no, he is not.' ... Pelek turns to me and his eyes gleam, 'Aren’t you a cleric?'

subject: The Cavern with Explosive Gases
fact: A cavern with a ledge on either side and a large basin below, emitting a peculiar smell recognized as explosive gases, where an eight-legged octopus attacks the party.
source_quote: We find ourselves in a cavern with a ledge to either side, and a large basin lies below. The basin has a peculiar smell that I recognize as explosive gases.

subject: The Collapsed Tunnel
fact: A tunnel where a tremor causes the passageways ahead and behind to collapse, forcing the party to follow a hidden passage discovered by Jimjar.
source_quote: As we were walking down a tunnel, a tremor caused the passageways ahead and behind us to collapse.

subject: The Circle of Explorers
fact: The Circle of Explorers is a gathering point near an exit hole where Rasharoo, Loobamub, and hunters are in a deep mind meld after fleeing the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: I can tell they are in a deep mind meld. ... Rasharoo, Loobamub, and the circle of hunters and explorers have gathered near one of the exit holes that Rasharoo had identified.

subject: The Inner Circle
fact: The Inner Circle is the location where Phylo, Basidia, and the party confront each other, surrounded by sentient Zurkhwoods that begin to move.
source_quote: We are in the Inner Circle, and there is Phylo. ... The sentient Zurkhwoods are starting to move.

subject: Rasharoo and Basidia
fact: Rasharoo and Basidia are the names of a Myconid stronghold and its Sovereign, where the party reports their findings and prepares to flee the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: We quickly march back to Rasharoo and Basidia. We tell them everything. And they are horrified. Basidia insists on going to confront Phylo now.

subject: The Neverlight Grove
fact: The Neverlight Grove is a corrupted fungal ecosystem under the control of Phylo and the Great Seeder, where madness spreads, Myconids are altered, and mock weddings are performed.
source_quote: The Neverlight Grove will be better than ever! And the Great Seeder will make us all happy!' ... The thralls enact a mock wedding... And the denizens of the Underdark have been driven mad and can’t seem to defend themselves.

subject: Blingdenstone
fact: Blingdenstone is a subterranean city that the party aims to reach, referenced as a destination where Jimjar claims he can guide them and where help may be found.
source_quote: I’ll bet you I can get you there!' ... Rasharoo tells us that he can provide us with a guide for half the distance to Blingdenstone, but after that, we are on our own.

subject: Menzoberranzan
fact: Menzoberranzan is the drow city that Ilvara has promised the party will reach, and her pursuit is driven by fear of becoming a Drider if they are not found.
source_quote: Ilvara promised that we would arrive in Menzoberranzan. Who knows what money exchanged hands? And then to make matters worse, the outpost of Velkynvelve was destroyed. She needs to find us, lest she become a Drider.

subject: Velkynvelve
fact: Velkynvelve is an outpost that has been destroyed, increasing Ilvara’s urgency to find the party before she is punished by becoming a Drider.
source_quote: And then to make matters worse, the outpost of Velkynvelve was destroyed. She needs to find us, lest she become a Drider.

subject: The Cavern with the Giant Mushroom
fact: A cavern dominated by a towering mushroom, Yggmorgus, surrounded by a carpet of fungi, thousands of smaller fungi clinging to its central stalk, and emitting a stench of rot and decay.
source_quote: The towering mushroom’s size at this distance... Thousands of smaller fungi cling to the central stalk, which itself splits into several lesser stalks, each long enough with a cap big enough to be the top of a great tower. A carpet of fungi covers the cavern floor surrounding the stalk. A stench of rot and decay wraps around me, seemingly threatening to penetrate my flesh and pervade my soul.

subject: The Circle of Welcome
fact: The Circle of Welcome is a chamber where mutated corpses are seen, and where the mock wedding rehearsal takes place under the influence of the Great Seeder.
source_quote: I think about those mutated corpses in the Circle of Welcome, and wonder what the problem means for a Drow.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is a pursuer who has promised the party will arrive in Menzoberranzan, and will not rest until they are found or she becomes a Drider.
source_quote: Ilvara promised that we would arrive in Menzoberranzan. Who knows what money exchanged hands? And then to make matters worse, the outpost of Velkynvelve was destroyed. She needs to find us, lest she become a Drider. She won’t rest until we are either found or she is dead.

subject: The Great Seeder
fact: The Great Seeder is a mysterious entity allied with Phylo, claiming to make the Neverlight Grove better and all Myconids happy.
source_quote: The Great Seeder will make us all happy!'

subject: Xinaya
fact: Xinaya is a corpse from which treasure is collected by Zalthir after the party flees the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: On our way back, we stop to pick up any treasure from the corpse of Xinaya. Zalthir, before we can do anything, has run up to the corpse and stuffed everything in his bag.

subject: The Circle of Explorers
fact: The Circle of Explorers is a gathering point near an exit hole where Rasharoo, Loobamub, and hunters are in a deep mind meld after fleeing the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: I can tell they are in a deep mind meld. ... Rasharoo, Loobamub, and the circle of hunters and explorers have gathered near one of the exit holes that Rasharoo had identified.

subject: The Underdark
fact: The Underdark is the vast subterranean realm where the party travels, haunted by madness, fungal horrors, and the pursuit of Ilvara.
source_quote: And once again into the dark. ... As we head into the Underdark, Rasharoo tells us that he can provide us with a guide for half the distance to Blingdenstone, but after that, we are on our own.

subject: Loobamub
fact: Loobamub is a Myconid ally of Rasharoo, gathered with the Circle of Explorers after fleeing the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: Rasharoo, Loobamub, and the circle of hunters and explorers have gathered near one of the exit holes that Rasharoo had identified.

subject: Zurkhwood
fact: Zurkhwood is a sentient fungal tree referenced as beneficial for digestion and used as a material in furniture and architecture.
source_quote: Eat more Zurkhwood, it's good for your digestion.

subject: Rasharoo
fact: Rasharoo is a Myconid stronghold and leadership center where the party reports their findings and prepares to flee the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: We quickly march back to Rasharoo and Basidia. We tell them everything. And they are horrified.

subject: The Cavern with the Collapsed Tunnel
fact: A tunnel where a tremor causes the passageways ahead and behind to collapse, forcing the party to follow a hidden passage discovered by Jimjar.
source_quote: As we were walking down a tunnel, a tremor caused the passageways ahead and behind us to collapse.

subject: The Tunnel with the Eight-Legged Octopus
fact: A tunnel where an eight-legged octopus attacks the party after they walk around a ledge above a basin emitting explosive gases.
source_quote: We carefully walk around the ledge, and as we reach the end, a large eight legged octopus attacks us.

subject: The Passageway Discovered by Jimjar
fact: A hidden passageway discovered by Jimjar after a tunnel collapse, leading into more caves, which the party follows despite uncertainty.
source_quote: He points to a place that we didn’t notice before, a passageway that leads into more caves. 'We should go in there!' he declares.

subject: The Chamber with the Large Mushroom
fact: A chamber where the procession returns after the mock wedding, dominated by the giant mushroom Yggmorgus, surrounded by luminescent fungi and the stench of decay.
source_quote: When the vision is over, I see the procession going back down the ledge into the chamber with the large mushroom.
